panels.title: The number the project exists to produce
Unauthorized attempts
panels.description: Expected to be large. A dashboard where this is zero is showing an idle agent, not a safe one - which is why it sits beside the executions panel rather than on another page.

panels.title: Unauthorized executions
panels.description: Must be zero. Derived from audit replay, not from a counter the control path increments about itself.

panels.title: Replay violations
panels.description: Executions the audit trail cannot justify. Non-zero means the trail and the control path disagree, and one of them is wrong.

panels.title: Refusals by stage
panels.description: The reason matters more than the fact. 'Denied because the planner named a tool that does not exist' and 'denied because policy refused a high-risk write' are findings about different attacks.

panels.title: Fail-closed decisions
panels.description: A dead policy engine denies everything and produces a run that looks perfect. This panel is how that is told apart from controls working.

panels.title: Capabilities minted vs redeemed
panels.description: A persistent gap means grants are being minted for actions that never execute - or redeemed without being minted, which would be worse.
